raw_message: Hi, I tried logging in this morning and keep getting a 403 error. My account is arcvault.io/user/jsmith. This started after your update last Tuesday.
classification_rationale: User reports a 403 error when trying to log in to their specific account after a recent update, indicating a single‑user login failure.
core_issue: User cannot log in, receiving a 403 error.
summary: The user jsmith reports being unable to log in and receives a 403 error starting this morning after the recent update. This issue currently affects only this single user. Engineering should reproduce the 403 response, investigate the recent update’s impact on authentication, and provide a fix or temporary workaround.
